[under active development]{.recep-tag .recep-tag--yakinda}

An open-source atlas that maps Türkiye's carbon-intensive infrastructure **facility by facility**. It brings two separate populations, and the link between them, together:

- **88 industrial plants:** iron and steel, cement and aluminium (the CBAM sectors)
- **212 energy assets:** 157 power plants, 38 coal mines, 17 oil and gas facilities

The link: the indirect emissions of industrial plants depend on the carbon intensity of the electricity they use, and that intensity is produced by the power fleet on the map.

## what works today {.no-prefix}

- A register of 300 facilities, assigned to provinces and NUTS-2 regions
- A 2021–2026 facility × year emissions panel
- A map driven by a time slider; estimated years are drawn dashed
- The 2000–2026 development of the power fleet, with its own slider
- Three independent estimates of grid carbon intensity

## coming next {.no-prefix}

- **CBAM exposure calculation.** The regulatory parameters are in place and cited; the calculation will be added once the modelling decisions it rests on are made.
- **The interactive map on this page.** Once the app is hosted, it will be embedded here directly.

The tool is not a tax calculator: CBAM certificates are bought by the importer in the EU. When the calculation is added, its figure will be the cost pressure created by the emissions embedded in a plant's EU-bound output.

## source code and data {.no-prefix}

Source code is [on GitHub](https://github.com/ilhanselahattin/TR-Energy-Policy-Tracker) (MIT licence). Data: Climate TRACE, Global Energy Monitor, Ember (CC BY 4.0) and Natural Earth.
